before: The review pane opened itself on load and on the first tracked change. scrollToBlock always put the block near the top. A picker opened by a click ignored Escape.
after: reviewModule({ paneOpening: 'manual' }) keeps the pane closed until the host opens it. scrollToBlock takes an optional block placement. Escape closes an open toolbar picker.
reason: Pane visibility, scroll position, and picker state are local view state. No shared document state or operation changes.
